newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Halla wins $160 mln shipbuilding orders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Halla wins $160 mln shipbuilding orders.

text.p: South Korea's Halla Engineering and Heavy Industries Co said on Wednesday it has won two foreign orders, worth a combined $160 million, to build five tankers.
A Halla statement said the orders had been received from Panama's Eastern Symphony S.A. and Twin Castle Shipping S.A.
It said Halla plans to deliver the 45,000 deadweight tonne tankers between the second half of 1998 and early 1999.
The double-hulled tankers for petroleum products will be 180 metres long and 32.2 metres wide.
Halla has won a total of $450 million worth of shipbuilding orders so far this year, the statement said.
